dailyHeadline: UNDEFEATED CAAAAM ON THE ROPES AS 1-9 CEREALSTROKE TORCHES ELORD11 IN WEEK 11 CHAOS
dailySubhead: 10-0 Caaaam clings to a 7.96-point lead over witness-protection sniper CarlaCote heading into Monday night, while PrayingGrantis and Unanswered are separated by 2.7 points in a Kingston heavyweight bout.
tickerTape: WEEK 11 LIVE: Caaaam (132.76) clinging to slim lead over CarlaCote (124.80) as 10-0 streak faces Ryan Center stress test
BOTTOM-FEEDER UPRISING: 1-9 CerealStroke (148.24) pummeling 3-7 trade addict ELord11 (121.66) after actually using Free Agency for SF DEF & Chimere Dike
NAILBITER ALERT: League-leading scorer PrayingGrantis (111.20) barely holding off 5-5 Unanswered (108.50) in Week 11 thriller
WEEK 10 RECAP: Shipoopiehole (152.56) edged Tylero0 (152.14) by 0.42 points before dropping $5 FAAB pickup Seth McGowan four days later
LATEST BLOCKBUSTER: CarlaCote stole Nico Collins & Blake Corum from PrayingGrantis for Matthew Golden on Nov 14—zero FAAB spent, maximum highway robbery
WAIVER WIRE WATCH: ELord11 spent his final $1 of dignity on the Jaguars DEF Saturday night while riding a 5-game losing streak

roasts.headline: CarlaCote Walks Out of Witness Protection and Robs PrayingGrantis Blind for Nico Collins
roasts.body:
Somebody check the Kingston campus security cameras outside the Memorial Union, because CarlaCote just pulled off the cleanest daylight heist since Caaaam convinced himself spending 50 FAAB on a Week 1 defense was a masterclass. On November 14, CarlaCote—who has spent a grand total of $7 FAAB all season and barely leaves a footprint on the waiver wire—somehow pried Nico Collins and Blake Corum away from PrayingGrantis in exchange for... Matthew Golden. Let that sink in like a rainy Monday morning commute down Route 138.

PrayingGrantis leads the entire Rhody league in scoring at 1532.72 points and has spent the season assembling superteams like he's playing Dynasty with cheat codes enabled, yet he apparently decided his 232.22 bench points needed a little more Green Bay flavor at the cost of a WR1 and a Rams handcuff. Meanwhile, CarlaCote quietly rides a two-game win streak to 6-4, sitting at 1374.82 PF while giving Caaaam absolute fits at 132.76 to 124.80 in Week 11.

And let's not forget ELord11, the league's resident compulsive trade addict who is currently trapped in a 5-game losing spiral at 3-7. Over the past month, ELord11 shipped out Kyren Williams, Omarion Hampton, Josh Jacobs, Jaylen Waddle, and Puka Nacua across three separate trades—and what does he have to show for it? Trey McBride, A.J. Brown, Drake London, Garrett Wilson, and a Week 11 beatdown at the hands of 1-9 CerealStroke.

roasts.headline: 10-0 Caaaam Sweats Bullets Against CarlaCote While CerealStroke Embarrasses ELord11
roasts.body:
The crown in Kingston is wobbling. Caaaam rolled into Week 11 at a pristine 10-0 with 1510.16 points for and the softest schedule in Rhody history (1225.56 points against), probably already drafting his latest smug league newsletter and sharpening his trade-veto stamp. Instead, he's locked in a 132.76 to 124.80 dogfight with CarlaCote, whose entire roster strategy consists of hiding in witness protection and letting opposing managers implode.

Elsewhere on the slate, the upset of the century is brewing at Keaney: 1-9 CerealStroke, who has famously boycotted FAAB all season ($0 spent, 1056.80 PF), is dropping a 148.24-point nuclear bomb on ELord11 (121.66) right after posting 164.18 in Week 10 to crush owenriddell. Apparently CerealStroke woke up from a two-month coma near Narragansett Pier, remembered he had a Sleeper login, and decided to ruin everybody's Thanksgiving week.

Keep one eye glued to Unanswered (108.50) vs. PrayingGrantis (111.20), separated by just 2.70 points with the 5-5 bubble team fighting for its playoff life. Meanwhile, Tylero0 (126.64) is comfortably bullying owenriddell (81.78), who hasn't sniffed triple digits since the Carter administration and is staring squarely at an 8th consecutive loss, while JewsInParis (113.84) is taking care of Shipoopiehole (90.10) to snap a two-game skid.

roasts.headline: Shipoopiehole Burns $5 FAAB on Seth McGowan Only to Dump Him 85 Hours Later
roasts.body:
If you ever wanted a textbook definition of panic-clicking at Butterfield Dining Hall, pull up Shipoopiehole's transaction log from this past week. At 3:07 AM on Tuesday, Shipoopiehole outbid the field with $5 of his remaining FAAB to secure Colts running back Seth McGowan—fresh off a thrilling 0.42-point Week 10 victory over Tylero0 (152.56 to 152.14). By Friday afternoon at 4:09 PM, McGowan was unceremoniously kicked to the curb for Chig Okonkwo. That's $5 FAAB for three days of roster rent and zero starts.

Not to be outdone in the comedy department, ELord11 fired off a $1 waiver claim on Saturday night at 8:56 PM for the Jacksonville Jaguars defense—literally 48 hours after 2-8 owenriddell dropped that exact same Jaguars defense for Detroit. You know things are bleak at 3-7 when you're digging through owenriddell's trash bin like a raccoon behind the Emporium.

Credit where it's due, though: CerealStroke finally discovered the 'Add Player' button without touching his spotless $0 FAAB balance, scooping the 49ers defense and Titans receiver Chimere Dike for free on Friday. Meanwhile, JewsInParis quietly punted Jordan Addison to the curb for Elic Ayomanor, and PrayingGrantis dumped Chris Rodriguez Jr. for Kirk Cousins—because nothing screams '7-3 superteam' quite like stashing 2026 Kirk Cousins on your bench.

roasts.headline: Three-Way 7-3 Logjam Behind 10-0 Caaaam While Shipoopiehole Fights Schedule God's Wrath
roasts.body:
The Rhody playoff race heading down the stretch looks like Route 1 at 5:00 PM on a Friday. Caaaam (10-0, 1510.16 PF) has basically clinched a bye and a permanent podium at the Ryan Center, but right behind him is a chaotic three-way tie at 7-3 between PrayingGrantis (1532.72 PF), Tylero0 (1475.48 PF), and JewsInParis (1450.16 PF). PrayingGrantis holds the league scoring crown despite leaving a staggering 232.22 points rotting on his bench, while JewsInParis has weathered a brutal 1414.74 points against—and still somehow stayed 7-3 despite trading Drake London for Jordan Mason earlier in the dark ages.

Sitting right on the bubble are CarlaCote (6-4, 1374.82 PF) and Unanswered (5-5, 1294.50 PF). Unanswered has already burned all $100 of his FAAB and desperately needs a miracle 2.7-point swing tonight against PrayingGrantis to avoid falling below .500. Below them lies the Island of Misfit Toys: ELord11 (3-7, 5L), Shipoopiehole (2-8), owenriddell (2-8, 7L), and CerealStroke (1-9).

Pour one out for Shipoopiehole, who has scored 1195.48 points—nearly 140 more than CerealStroke—yet has absorbed an absurd 1508.60 points against. That's nearly 283 more points against than Caaaam has faced. The fantasy gods didn't just frown on Shipoopiehole; they parked a campus shuttle bus on his chest.

powerRankings.blurb: At 10-0 with 1510.16 PF and a league-best 1225.56 PA, Caaaam is cruising through Kingston even after dropping Jason Sanders and lighting all $100 FAAB on fire. He's holding onto a 132.76 to 124.80 lead over CarlaCote in Week 11, proving even veto-happy newsletter writers get nervous sometimes.

The 7-3 juggernaut leads the league with 1532.72 PF after torching JewsInParis for 176.14 in Week 10, though his league-worst 232.22 bench points suggest he closes his eyes when setting lineups. Gifting Nico Collins and Blake Corum to CarlaCote for Matthew Golden was bizarre, yet he's still up 111.20 to 108.50 on Unanswered.

Tylero0 sits at 7-3 with 1475.48 PF and is bouncing back nicely from a brutal 0.42-point Week 10 loss to Shipoopiehole by stomping owenriddell 126.64 to 81.78 in Week 11. Dropping Tank Dell for Jacory Croskey-Merritt and grabbing Puka Nacua in Week 9 keeps this fleece-merchant squarely in title contention.

With only $7 FAAB spent all year and a 6-4 record (1374.82 PF), CarlaCote keeps sneaking out of witness protection to put up monster scores like Week 10's 167.26. Pulling Nico Collins and Blake Corum out of PrayingGrantis's pocket for Matthew Golden has her threatening Caaaam's 10-0 streak at 124.80 to 132.76.

Somehow 7-3 with 1450.16 PF despite facing 1414.74 PA and carrying the eternal shame of trading Drake London for Jordan Mason, JewsInParis is stopping a 2-game skid by leading Shipoopiehole 113.84 to 90.10. Cutting Jordan Addison for Elic Ayomanor shows he's still tinkering with the bottom of the barrel.

At 5-5 with 1294.50 PF and $0 FAAB left in the tank, Unanswered is fighting for survival down 108.50 to 111.20 against PrayingGrantis in Week 11. Acquiring Josh Jacobs and Jaylen Waddle for A.J. Brown was a solid Week 9 pivot, but losing Week 10 to Caaaam leaves zero margin for error.

Five straight losses have dropped the compulsive trade addict to 3-7 (1289.30 PF), and he's currently getting humbled 148.24 to 121.66 by 1-9 CerealStroke. After flipping half the NFL roster across four trades and spending $1 FAAB on Jacksonville's defense, maybe it's time to log off Sleeper for a week.

Don't look now, Kingston: 1-9 CerealStroke ($0 FAAB used, 1056.80 PF) dropped 164.18 in Week 10 and is hanging 148.24 on ELord11 right now. Adding the 49ers defense and Chimere Dike for free finally woke this dormant roster up, even if 214.44 bench points shows how much potential rotted earlier.

A 2-8 record with a league-worst 1508.60 PA proves the fantasy schedule hates Shipoopiehole, even after his thrilling 152.56 to 152.14 upset of Tylero0 in Week 10. Trailing JewsInParis 90.10 to 113.84 while burning $5 FAAB on Seth McGowan just to cut him for Chig Okonkwo screams chaos.

Seven consecutive losses, 2-8 overall, 1155.18 PF, and an ugly 81.78-point showing against Tylero0 after scoring 86.52 in Week 10—owenriddell is officially at rock bottom. Trading Trey McBride and Emeka Egbuka in Week 7 hasn't stopped the bleeding, and streaming Detroit's defense won't fix a roster on life support.

tradeGrades.summary: CarlaCote received Nico Collins (WR - HOU) and Blake Corum (RB - LAR); PrayingGrantis received Matthew Golden (WR - GB).
tradeGrades.verdict: CarlaCote emerged from witness protection long enough to turn Matthew Golden into a true alpha WR1 in Nico Collins plus a valuable RB handcuff in Blake Corum. PrayingGrantis has enough depth to survive it, but this looks like an unforced charitable donation.

tradeGrades.summary: Tylero0 received Puka Nacua (WR - LAR); ELord11 received Drake London (WR - ATL) and Garrett Wilson (WR - NYJ).
tradeGrades.verdict: Tylero0 somehow flipped his usual fleece script into getting the single best player in the deal in Puka Nacua to fuel a 7-3 push. ELord11 got two solid receivers in London and Wilson, yet his 5-game losing streak proves quantity doesn't always cure a trade addiction.

tradeGrades.summary: Unanswered received Josh Jacobs (RB - GB) and Jaylen Waddle (WR - DEN); ELord11 received A.J. Brown (WR - NE).
tradeGrades.verdict: Unanswered landed a workhorse RB1 in Josh Jacobs and a usable WR2 in Jaylen Waddle just to part with A.J. Brown. ELord11 got his shiny WR1, but he thinned out his own depth right in the middle of a brutal November slide.

tradeGrades.summary: ELord11 received Trey McBride (TE - ARI) and Emeka Egbuka (WR - TB); owenriddell received Kyren Williams (RB - LAR), Omarion Hampton (RB - LAC), and Tyler Warren (TE - IND).
tradeGrades.verdict: On paper owenriddell got huge RB value with Kyren Williams and Omarion Hampton plus a solid tight end pivot in Tyler Warren, even though his team still cratered to 2-8. ELord11 got an elite tight end in Trey McBride and Emeka Egbuka, yet neither manager escaped the Rhody basement.
